notes:
NEXORA 1.0.34

**Added**

- **Motion system** — tokenized duration tiers and easing families, press micro-feedback on the sidebar and controls, panel swaps with busy spinners, and exit choreography for modals, dropdowns and toasts across Dashboard, Settings, Tools, Performance and Library.
- **Tray rework** — accent-tinted 32×32 icons on each menu item, EN/ID labels, a versioned title row, and event-driven refresh of text and icon colors whenever the language or accent changes.
- **Shared UI primitives** — Button, Card, Toggle, EmptyState, SegmentedControl, SectionTitle and SettingRow, now driving the Battery, Game Booster, Hardware Monitor, Settings and Profile pages.
- **Settings > About shows the build kind and source commit**, and dev builds run under their own identity so a dev instance can never be mistaken for the installed app.

**Changed**

- **Every surface is now solid** — all glassmorphism and transparency removed; colors and radii tokenized through a shared scale on every page.
- **All pages render through one shared page frame** (PageContainer), with a consistent head, spacing and density; the process list head now renders through that frame too.
- **Release notes are template-shaped** — the update publisher writes the full formatted release body (highlights, details, download table) and gains a `--notes-only` mode that restyles an existing release without re-uploading assets.
- **Dev workflow scripts** — `dev-restart.ps1` closes every NEXORA instance then launches the dev build, and `copy-dev-data.ps1` seeds the empty dev data folder from the installed one.

**Fixed**

- **Dashboard header refresh/pause icons restored** (they were squeezed into slivers) and chart corner labels no longer stack when scale and duration share the bottom-right.
- **Library Discover cards are readable** — solid text zone, opaque buttons, initials placeholder, no-lift hover — and the profile ambient background layer fades without a hard edge.
- **Settings now apply theme and accent only after the store has loaded**, seed the accent draft from the live store, retry the DB load, keep a backup of the accent and roll back failed writes.
- **Badge text stays solid and readable** on solid-accent active chips.
